Upon release, Celimene was a top-tier flank. Her ability to hit three hard and lock their status made her a menace in wars. She was a "Blue Hurricane" alternative for those who missed the Ninja.
The numbers don't lie. Her stats are essentially 4-star level compared to the latest releases (Power 902 vs 1260+). Her 400% hit doesn't sting like it used to against 1300+ defense stats.

She is no longer a defense team candidate. In offense, she serves a specific role: providing the Bard mana bonus and locking down defense debuffs on key targets. She is viable in mid-tier wars and tournaments but will struggle to survive or kill in top 100 play without significant protection.

If you pulled Celimene early, she is a star. Her hit-3 mechanic will clear map stages and low-tier raids effortlessly. Prioritize her leveling as she will be your main damage dealer and support for a long time. The mana bonus is invaluable when your troops are low level.

Community consensus often places her as a "side-grade" or slightly inferior to Adalinda due to Adalinda's fiends and higher defense down, but Celimene's cleanse block has its loyal defenders.

Celimene is the "Bard of Illusion" in more ways than one. She creates the illusion of being a pure damage dealer, but her true value lies in the subtle manipulation of mana and status effects. While she may not hit the high notes of damage like the latest Construct heroes, her melody still holds power in the right composition. She’s a beautiful, functional, and mechanically unique hero who deserves a spot on your bench—even if it's just to look pretty.
A solid B+ in the modern era. Worth leveling for the family bonus, but keep her away from the front lines.
